supplements.title: 4‑Acetylantrocamol LT3 suppresses colorectal cancer growth and metastasis via PI3K/AKT and MAPK pathway modulation.
supplements.summary: A fungal compound called LT3 effectively stops colorectal cancer growth and spread by blocking key cancer-promoting pathways.

supplements.title: Chaihu-Shugan-San ameliorates chronic atrophic gastritis by inhibiting nuclear factor-kappa B-mediated inflammation and apoptosis.
supplements.summary: A traditional Chinese medicine formula reduces stomach inflammation and cell death in chronic gastritis by blocking a key inflammatory pathway.

supplements.title: AMBP gene activation promotes cholangiocarcinoma progression through the WNT/β-catenin signaling pathway: Regulatory effect of polysaccharides from Auricularia auricula-judae.
supplements.summary: AMBP gene activation drives cholangiocarcinoma progression through the WNT pathway, while Huaier polysaccharide reverses this by inhibiting AMBP.

supplements.title: Chemical Space Navigation of Nitidine Leads to the Discovery of a Novel PD-L1 Degradation Agent by Targeting CSN5 for Enhanced Antitumor Immunity.
supplements.summary: Researchers discovered a new compound (e24) that degrades PD-L1 on cancer cells by targeting CSN5, enhancing immune responses against tumors in mouse models.

supplements.title: Chemopreventive Potential of Brucine-Gold Nanoparticles (BRU-AuNPs) in DMBA-induced Mammary Cancer via Modulation of PI3K/AKT/mTOR Pathway.
supplements.summary: Brucine-gold nanoparticles prevent mammary cancer in rats by reducing tumors and blocking cancer-promoting cellular pathways.

supplements.title: Interactions between nutrition and the epigenome: how can it be harnessed for public health?
supplements.summary: Diet influences how genes are expressed through epigenetic changes, offering potential for public health strategies to prevent disease and aging.

supplements.title: Higher serum zinc micronutrient levels are associated with reduced susceptibility to Group B Streptococcus rectovaginal colonisation in pregnant women.
supplements.summary: Higher zinc levels in pregnant women reduce Group B Streptococcus colonization, potentially lowering newborn infection risk.

supplements.title: Multi-omics and network pharmacology identify IGFBP1 as an m6A-Epigenetic target of pueraria in NSCLC therapy.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified IGFBP1 as a therapeutic target in lung cancer, finding that Pueraria compounds can bind to it and potentially block cancer progression.

supplements.title: Phenolic compounds and chemotherapeutic agents differentially regulate P2X receptor subtypes in malignant melanoma.
supplements.summary: Phenolic compounds and chemotherapy drugs differently regulate P2X receptors in melanoma cells, offering new targets for treatment.

supplements.title: Characterization and anticancer bioactivity of the fungal immunomodulatory protein FIP-Gre from Ganoderma resinaceum.
supplements.summary: A protein from medicinal mushrooms called FIP-Gre shows promise as a potential anticancer agent through immune system activation.

supplements.title: Diet Modulates Cardiac Metabolic Stress During Anthracycline Treatment.
supplements.summary: A healthy vegan diet may protect heart health better than omnivorous diets in cancer patients receiving anthracycline chemotherapy.

supplements.title: Metabologenomic Hallmark-Based Discovery of Bacterial Thioamides as a New Lead against Drug-Resistant Pancreatic Cancer.
supplements.summary: Researchers discovered bacterial compounds called thioamides that effectively kill drug-resistant pancreatic cancer cells by blocking a key growth pathway.

supplements.title: Wogonin-derived chemotype enables discovery of novel GLS1 inhibitors with potent antitumor activity.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed LX-191, a new drug that blocks glutaminase-1 to stop cancer cells from using glutamine, potentially overcoming limitations of existing treatments.

supplements.title: Terminalia chebula Extract Alleviates Lipopolysaccharide-Induced Acute Lung Injury by Modulating the Interleukin-17-Dependent Mitogen-Activated Protein Kinase/Nuclear Factor-Kappa B Signaling Pathways.
supplements.summary: Terminalia chebula extract reduces lung injury by suppressing inflammation through the IL-17 signaling pathway in mice.

supplements.title: Synergistic anticancer and antimicrobial efficacy of betanin and IR806 co-encapsulated liposomes against triple-negative breast cancer.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed nanoparticles combining two compounds that kill triple-negative breast cancer cells and bacteria when activated by near-infrared light.

off_label.title: A system biology-based identification of potential biomarker interlinking the effect of anti-diabetic drug, Metformin, on reduced occurrence of hepatocellular carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Metformin reduces hepatocellular carcinoma risk by targeting protein kinase B, a key protein in cancer development pathways.

off_label.title: Effect of anticancer activity of aripiprazole main metabolite OPC-14857 on malignant glioblastoma.
off_label.summary: Aripiprazole's metabolite OPC-14857 shows potent anticancer effects against glioblastoma, potentially outperforming current standard treatment.

off_label.title: Combining lenalidomide with IL-2 family of cytokines enhances activating receptor and perforin/granzyme expression in NK cells.
off_label.summary: Combining lenalidomide with IL-2 cytokines boosts natural killer cell activity, potentially improving cancer treatment while reducing side effects.

off_label.title: Lipid Droplet-Targeted Biomimetic Liposomes Potentiate Chemo-Ferroptosis Therapy in Leukemia.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a targeted treatment combining chemotherapy and ferroptosis that overcomes drug resistance in leukemia by disrupting protective lipid structures in cancer cells.

off_label.title: Role of autophagy in tumorigenesis and drug resistance: molecular mechanisms and therapeutic targets.
off_label.summary: Autophagy both suppresses early cancer formation but paradoxically enables tumor growth and drug resistance in advanced stages, suggesting it as a therapeutic target.

off_label.title: Glucocorticoids mediate fasting efficacy in breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Fasting helps hormone-positive breast cancer patients by activating a protein called the glucocorticoid receptor, which could be targeted with drugs instead of requiring strict diets.

off_label.title: Pluripotent stem-cell-based screening uncovers sildenafil as a mitochondrial disease therapy.
off_label.summary: Researchers discovered that sildenafil, an existing drug, can treat Leigh syndrome, a severe mitochondrial disease, by restoring brain cell function.

off_label.title: Low-dose nivolumab with neoadjuvant chemotherapy and oral metronomic therapy in borderline resectable oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma: a phase II trial.
off_label.summary: Low-dose immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy and oral metronomic therapy improved surgical conversion rates in borderline resectable oral cancer.

off_label.title: Conserved use of tetraspanin CD9 as an entry receptor by rhabdoviruses spanning multiple genera.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified CD9 protein as a shared entry receptor for multiple rhabdoviruses across species and found nitazoxanide as a potential broad-spectrum antiviral treatment.

off_label.title: Accelerated discovery of cell migration regulators using label-free deep learning-based automated tracking.
off_label.summary: DeepBIT, a label-free AI tracking system, rapidly identified breast cancer cell migration regulators among FDA-approved drugs and genetic perturbations.

off_label.title: Safety and Efficacy of Esomeprazole-Containing Regimens for Helicobacter pylori Eradication: A Multicenter Retrospective Study.
off_label.summary: Esomeprazole-based treatments effectively and safely eliminate H. pylori bacteria, reducing gastric cancer risk in both new and previously treated patients.

off_label.title: Doxorubicin-Induced Cardiotoxicity: Comprehensive Pathway Insights and Advanced Preclinical Therapeutics.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified multiple mechanisms causing heart damage from doxorubicin cancer drug and found that probiotics and natural compounds may help prevent it.

off_label.title: A hierarchical theranostic nanoagent for multimodal imaging and targeted foam cell intervention in atherosclerosis.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a nanoparticle that images atherosclerotic plaques and delivers cholesterol-lowering drugs directly to foam cells, stabilizing dangerous arterial plaques.

off_label.title: Single-cell RNA Sequencing Discovered Subtypes Associated with Angiogenesis and Propranolol Treatment in Infantile Hemangioma.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified two infantile hemangioma cell types targeted by propranolol, revealing how the drug suppresses blood vessel growth.

off_label.title: DGAT1 Inhibition Induces Ferroptosis and Enhances Cancer Immunotherapy Efficacy.
off_label.summary: Blocking DGAT1 protein triggers cancer cell death and boosts immune checkpoint therapy effectiveness by increasing immune cell infiltration.

biomarkers.title: Contrasting functions of CD73 and adenosine in CD8+ T-cell exhaustion during antitumor immunity.
biomarkers.summary: CD73 promotes exhaustion of tumor-fighting CD8+ T cells, while adenosine signaling helps maintain their self-renewing precursor state.

biomarkers.title: Nutritional-inflammatory indices optimize the diagnostic performance of FIB-4 for advanced fibrosis/cirrhosis in patients with benign liver disease.
biomarkers.summary: Combining FIB-4 with nutritional-inflammatory markers improves accuracy for detecting advanced liver scarring in patients with benign liver disease.

biomarkers.title: Super-enhancer-associated miR-1260b coordinates adipogenesis and metabolic programming in human adipose stem cells.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified miR-1260b, a genetic regulator linked to super-enhancers, that blocks fat cell formation and may help prevent obesity.

biomarkers.title: Elevated DOCK4 expression correlates with favorable prognosis and immune infiltration in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: High DOCK4 levels in kidney cancer predict better patient outcomes and boost immune cell activity against tumors.

biomarkers.title: Genetic and clinical determinants of tacrolimus accumulation in early liver transplantation: evidence for a combined genotype-antibiotic effect.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified how genetic factors and antibiotics together influence tacrolimus levels in liver transplant patients, improving drug dosing safety.

biomarkers.title: A system biology-based identification of potential biomarker interlinking the effect of anti-diabetic drug, Metformin, on reduced occurrence of hepatocellular carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Metformin reduces hepatocellular carcinoma risk by targeting protein kinase B, a key protein in cancer development pathways.

biomarkers.title: Silencing of SIVA‑1 promotes cisplatin resistance in gastric cancer via the Bcl‑2/BAX‑mediated mitochondria‑dependent apoptosis pathway.
biomarkers.summary: Silencing SIVA-1 increases cisplatin resistance in gastric cancer by blocking cell death pathways.

biomarkers.title: 4‑Acetylantrocamol LT3 suppresses colorectal cancer growth and metastasis via PI3K/AKT and MAPK pathway modulation.
biomarkers.summary: A fungal compound called LT3 effectively stops colorectal cancer growth and spread by blocking key cancer-promoting pathways.

biomarkers.title: Enolase 1: A paradigm of metabolic enzyme moonlighting in tumorigenesis (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Enolase 1 protein drives multiple cancer types through various functions beyond metabolism, offering promising new therapeutic targets for treatment.

biomarkers.title: Glucose‑driven TRIB3 enhances the tumorigenic potential of colon cancer via the PI3K/AKT pathway.
biomarkers.summary: High glucose levels increase a protein called TRIB3 in colon cancer, promoting tumor growth and spread through a specific cellular pathway.

biomarkers.title: Depleting HIF‑1α attenuates the progression of osteosarcoma, but tumorigenicity is sustained through HIF‑independent pathways.
biomarkers.summary: Removing HIF-1α slows osteosarcoma growth, but tumors survive through alternative pathways that vary between cells, requiring combination treatments.

biomarkers.title: POLQ promotes tumor progression and immunosuppression via ATM‑P53 signaling in endometrial cancer.
biomarkers.summary: POLQ protein drives endometrial cancer growth and immune suppression by activating ATM-P53 signaling and cell migration pathways.

biomarkers.title: HELLS inhibits autophagy‑dependent ferroptosis in nasopharyngeal carcinoma by modulating the Nrf2/HO‑1/GPX4 pathway.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking HELLS protein in nasopharyngeal cancer cells triggers cell death by enabling a ferroptosis process, offering a potential treatment approach.

biomarkers.title: Diverse roles of SERPINE1 in regulating cellular proliferation and invasion.
biomarkers.summary: SERPINE1 protein has opposite effects across cancers: reducing it slows breast cancer and glioma growth but increases melanoma growth through different cellular mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: Ferritin in ferroptosis: Implications for neurodegenerative diseases (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Ferritin regulates iron levels in the brain; its dysfunction may contribute to neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's.

trials.title: The dual roles of natural killer cells in liver immunity and tolerance: Implications for health and disease.
trials.summary: NK cells regulate liver immunity and tumor control; restoring their function through CAR-NK therapy may treat hepatocellular carcinoma.

trials.title: IDH enzyme inhibition in cancer therapy: mechanisms, mutational insights, and effects of IDH inhibitors in glioma, acute myeloid leukemia and chondrosarcoma.
trials.summary: IDH inhibitors reduce tumor size and improve survival in glioma, AML, and chondrosarcoma, though resistance mechanisms can develop.

trials.title: Identification of a 9-gene autophagy-related signature for predicting prognosis and immune exhaustion features in breast cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers identified nine genes linked to autophagy that predict breast cancer survival and treatment response to specific chemotherapy drugs.

trials.title: Surgical Outcomes of Prepectoral Two-Stage Breast Reconstruction in Patients Treated with Pembrolizumab or CDK4/6 Inhibitors.
trials.summary: Breast cancer patients on pembrolizumab or CDK4/6 inhibitors can safely undergo two-stage breast reconstruction with comparable surgical outcomes.

trials.title: Epidemiology of ischemic lesions after diffuse low-grade glioma resection: a Scandinavian multicenter study.
trials.summary: Brain surgery for low-grade gliomas risks causing stroke-like injuries that may worsen patient neurological outcomes.

trials.title: Facilitators of and Barriers to Implementation of a Tablet-Based Digital Health Program for Colorectal Cancer Screening in Primary Care: Qualitative Pragmatic Implementation Study.
trials.summary: A tablet app helps primary care doctors identify patients needing colorectal cancer screening and encourages them to request tests.

trials.title: The effect of opium consumption on prostate cancer among Iranian patients: A retrospective analytical study.
trials.summary: Opium users had lower prostate cancer detection rates and PSA levels than non-users, suggesting opium may affect cancer detection.

trials.title: T-cell lymphoblastic lymphoma of the breast: A retrospective observational study and literature review.
trials.summary: Breast T-cell lymphoblastic lymphoma is extremely rare; accurate diagnosis through immunohistochemistry and imaging guides chemotherapy treatment.

trials.title: Bilateral blindness from optic chiasm metastasis as the initial presentation of stage 4 neuroblastoma: A case report.
trials.summary: A child with advanced neuroblastoma presented with sudden blindness from cancer spreading to the optic nerve, an extremely rare occurrence.

trials.title: Relapse of adult B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia in the bilateral lacrimal glands: A case report and literature review.
trials.summary: Adult B-cell leukemia relapsed in both tear glands after stem cell transplant, a rare complication often misdiagnosed as inflammation.

trials.title: Dynamic monitoring of circulating cell-free EBV-DNA for risk assessment in early-stage natural killer/T-cell lymphoma.
trials.summary: Tracking EBV-DNA levels during treatment predicts survival outcomes in early-stage natural killer/T-cell lymphoma patients.

trials.title: Context-Dependent Role of GDF15: GDF15+ Tumor-Associated Macrophages Suppress OSCC Progression by Enhancing Phagocytosis.
trials.summary: GDF15 from immune cells suppresses oral cancer growth by boosting tumor cell destruction, while blocking secreted GDF15 enhances immunotherapy.

trials.title: Hypofractionated Radiotherapy Induces ISG15+MHC-I+ Neutrophils to Augment Anti-Tumor Immunity and Prime Immune Checkpoint Blockade Responses in Rectal Cancer.
trials.summary: Hypofractionated radiotherapy in rectal cancer activates special immune cells that boost anti-tumor immunity and improve immunotherapy effectiveness.

trials.title: Subtype-specific dependencies and therapeutic opportunities in small cell lung cancer.
trials.summary: Small cell lung cancer has distinct molecular subtypes with unique vulnerabilities that epigenetic therapies could exploit for better treatment outcomes.

trials.title: IL-7/IL-15/IL-21 cytokine-fusion scaffold generates highly functional CAR T cells enriched in long-lived T memory stem cells.
trials.summary: A new protein scaffold creates longer-lasting CAR T cells enriched in memory cells, improving treatment of HIV and leukemia.
